name: Unbiased Monte Carlo Estimator for Radiance and Radiance Derivatives
aliases: Joint Estimation of L(1) and L̂(1)
definition: An unbiased Monte Carlo approach that jointly estimates the first-order radiance derivative L(1) and the scene derivative L̂(1) by handling volumetric and interfacial events separately based on the free-flight distance relative to the boundary distance D.
summary: This method jointly estimates radiance and its first-order derivative in participating media by explicitly propagating scene derivatives alongside radiance values to enable differentiable rendering.
